old_problem: Equal read/write M.2 coverage conflicts with a read-only job, and the namespace, extent, runtime authorization and acceptance limits are missing.
disposition_reason: ED-04 makes any added write stream fail closed; it cannot itself authorize replacing randread with randrw. Because the intended correction creates destructive 50% write traffic, the source owner must decide the command semantic before parameterization.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row7 all18 XLSX cells and history2623.
Preserved equal-mix M.2 coverage and the literal no-write behavior as separate evidence.
No namespace was selected and no fio command ran.

test_case.test_name: M.2 FIO QD1 512B equal read/write validation pending semantic approval
test_case.purpose: Measure equal-mix M.2 read/write IOPS, bandwidth and latency on one explicitly disposable namespace.
required_package: Approval to replace randread with randrw+rwmixread=50
Pinned fio build and reviewed job file
Disposable non-OS namespace with serial/controller/BDF, bounded range and access mode
Data-loss approval, NVMe abort limits and owner-led recovery
test_case.test_command: Keep the source job disabled. Once equal-mix authority exists, map and revalidate the exact namespace serial/controller/BDF, prove it is not OS/boot/mounted/RAID/held, capture health, run one bounded QD1 512B equal-mix job, save fio JSON/NVMe telemetry, and do not format or remount automatically.
test_case.expected_result: The approved equal mix reaches its limits on only the designated namespace without new NVMe, kernel, thermal or power faults.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an actual authorized 50/50 job plus numeric limits; randread evidence cannot satisfy the write half of this case.
safety_gate: Do not introduce writes before explicit semantic and data-loss approval.
Reject OS, boot, mounted, RAID-member and open-holder namespaces.
Pin namespace serial, extent and runtime immediately before launch.
Stop on NVMe critical warning/media/thermal/power error; never auto-retry.
expected_evidence: Pre/post NVMe SMART/error and kernel logs
fio JSON confirming actual 50/50 mix and metrics
test_case.recovery: If any write reaches an unapproved namespace or the actual mix is not equal, terminate fio, snapshot namespace/controller health and kernel evidence, prevent remount, and let the M.2 owner determine data restoration or secure format before release.

source_conflict.reason: The M.2 equal-mix objective remains incompatible with the read-only randread procedure.
